points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable 05261f8 clean CMake build passes with warnings in network-disabled cfd-bench, 2 CPUs/3 GiB with /opt/external. No CFD rerun.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp parses solve/restart and case controls; io.cpp:61–65 writes only current U despite history parameters, and solver.cpp:1872–1873 resets both histories and starts physical loop at step 1 after restart.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Separated config, CGNS reader, mesh, partition, numerics, solver and I/O units; solver.cpp contains several complex numerical paths.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No source-evident internal existing-solver wrapper; external similarity search excluded by trust policy.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: main.cpp parses case JSON and configured CGNS path; no two-filename-only solver dispatch identified.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp:287–320 uses root-scoped global mesh, METIS and rank-local files; solver halo uses neighbor Isend/Irecv. Original np1/8 Re20 drag differs ~1.1%, source-to-output revision unproven.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Clean immutable build passes with warnings and positivity checks exist; io.cpp restart omits BDF histories/time continuation; root-only restart error may strand peers.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Immutable tests include many input fixtures and mesh_smoke; selected verification reports clean build/smoke/restart. No independent CFD rerun or full formal regression suite performed.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Curated source excludes raw/debug outputs by policy; selected verification reports uncommitted solver/tool changes and metadata lacks git_revision, limiting production traceability.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: solver.cpp:175 onward assembles conservative compressible viscous flow residual; actual production executable revision not established.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS reader, mixed geometry, cell-face graph and METIS adjacency are source-evident; independent geometry oracle not run.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp assembles face residual and global norms. Final source tests fresh-gradient BDF residual, but historical production binary origin and exact target misses are unproven.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: numerics.cpp implements Roe and Rusanov, with report case choices. Actual production revision remains unknown; no independent flux convergence study.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: solver.cpp farfield/slip/no-slip paths and output wall semantics exist; raw surface checks are available but actual source version of runs is unbound.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: solver.cpp:1308–1318 uses CFD_RECON_SCALE=0.5 in three manifest cases, explicitly disclosed; :1414–1456 permits CFD_GRAD_DAMP=0.5 in M2 inviscid, omitted from report. No order study.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Source implements Barth/Venkatakrishnan and positivity fallback; run manifest names Venkatakrishnan for Re200 and scaling exceptions. Exact producing source unproven.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: solver.cpp:487–542 computes viscous wall stress and projects onto tangent; raw laminar cases have force plots dominated by startup, and production source revision is unproven.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Source LU-SGS and optional matrix-free GMRES; output steady inner statistics vary across final revisions, and actual binary revision is not bound.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: solver.cpp:1875–1950,2240–2311 implements BDF1 startup, BDF2 and fresh-gradient total residual target. io.cpp:61–65 writes only current U and solver.cpp:1872–1873 resets both histories/time loop after restart. Metadata git_revision=null; strict target production origin remains unproven.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: main.cpp:287–320 root-only preprocessing, METIS and neighbor halo; raw np1/8 Re20 Cd differs ~1.1%, not order-one. Production source revision is unknown.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Eight canonical packages and report passed prior structural validator; source-to-run identity remains unproven and output visual limitations documented.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Prior validator returned rc0 for all eight final directories and report; it does not establish target-miss truth or identify producing binary.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Re200 reaches t300 with periodic lift, seven steady statuses converged; source-to-run revision and strict transient target claims are unverified.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Raw force tails/periods are documented; M0.15 inviscid Cd 0.0344 and laminar Cd 0.0118, gradient damping and Re200 lift amplitude suggest limitations without an independent grid study.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Three inviscid case plots show force evolution and contours; four steady viscous force plots and Re200 late drag are compressed by startup spikes. Figures remain traceable through report manifest.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: The 41-page report is detailed and candid about reconstruction blending, but does not disclose the M2 inviscid CFD_GRAD_DAMP=0.5 production setting.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Final verification notes uncommitted solver edits and case metadata git_revision=null, so exact production binary source is not proven. Run manifest and figures identify canonical paths.

sections.notes: Final Green-Gauss/limiter code present; three manifest cases use disclosed 0.5 reconstruction blend and M2 inviscid uses undocumented 0.5 gradient damping. No order study or binary binding.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: Source includes BDF2 and fresh-gradient total residual accounting, but io.cpp:61–65 saves only current U and solver.cpp:1872–1873 restarts histories/time at step 1. Exact Re200 binary source unproven.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: Root-scoped full mesh and METIS/neighbor halos; raw Re20 np1/8 Cd 2.1266/2.1034, ~1.1% spread. Production binary source not bound.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Eight packages structurally validate; laminar force tails, low-M drag discrepancy and source provenance limit confidence. Case-specific scores separately include plots.

sections.notes: Comprehensive report, but four steady viscous plots and Re200 late drag are flattened; M2 inviscid gradient damping omitted; exact production source unproven.

flags.notes: No source-evident internal existing solver executable; external similarity search excluded by trust policy.
Original force/residual histories and fields show case attempts; no direct proof of generating histories without solving. Producing binary identity is unbound.

Final source LU-SGS and matrix-free Newton/GMRES paths are present; no explicit-only finding.
Rusanov/Roe, reconstruction, viscous, LU-SGS and BDF2 source code exist; transient restart history is defective but not an absent method. Actual production binary identity is unknown.

Re200 has repeated lift oscillations and metadata records zero strict misses, but producing binary is unbound; final source counts fresh-gradient total residual. Cannot independently prove actual strict miss fraction; no supported DQ7 finding.
Committed figures and manifest identify case data; four viscous steady plots and Re200 late drag are compressed, but no proof figures come from unrelated output.
partition.cpp METIS and main.cpp root-scoped GlobalMesh/local partitions are implemented; no all-rank full mesh/state during iterations established.

Three manifest runs explicitly use 0.5 reconstruction blending and report discloses it. M2 inviscid gradient damping 0.5 is omitted, but this damps updates rather than disabling reconstruction; no supported DQ10 finding.
Slip/no-slip wall boundary output code and post-fix report describe boundary values; no direct evidence current report mislabels cell-center velocity. Actual binary source unbound.
Inspected Mach/vorticity figures and manifest match labeled variables; not exhaustive pixel audit.
No internal wrapper found; external similarity search excluded under trust policy.

limitations: No evaluator rerun was performed; Re200 was not rerun under the mandatory prohibition.
The result branch intentionally excludes raw case packages and the compiled report PDF; raw workspace evidence was inspected read-only but is not reproducible from result-tip Git alone.
run_identity.json and contestant_final_response.md are unindexed sidecars; cfdeval check does not validate either sidecar.

2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.
